_doc: Review policy read by review_gate.py. CI reads this file from the PR's base ref as merged there (git show origin/<base>:...), never from the PR head, so a PR cannot remove itself from the list; if the base ref has no copy it uses the trusted default-branch checkout. second_family_paths: fnmatch globs ("*" also matches "/"); a diff touching any of them needs a passing review (CLEAN, or FINDINGS disposed) from TWO different model families before the review check goes green. See docs/operations/github-workflow-conventions.md#second-family-review.
_boundary: Listed: files whose main job is an authentication or authorisation decision, or the wiring that configures one (mcp_server.py, mcp_listen_config.py), plus the review gate itself. updates/phases.py is listed despite its size because it holds the main strict-identity write gate (the caller-proven check for sync_state and the no-implicit-identity refusal); it and mcp_server.py together touch about 9% of src commits (42 of 469 in the 60 days to 2026-09-27). Deliberately NOT listed: large multi-purpose files that contain a single check (http_routes/sentinel.py, mcp_server_std.py, dialectic_protocol.py, mcp_handlers/wave3a_probe.py, mcp_handlers/consolidated.py); listing them would put most of the codebase under the rule. Also NOT listed: modules that sign records for integrity rather than gate access (dialectic_receipt.py, skill_attestations.py). Audited 2026-09-27 by grepping src/ for strict-identity refusals, compare_digest, CSRF, WebAuthn and trusted-network checks, then for signing, attestation, credential minting and verification, and reading each candidate's module docstring.
